notes: v530 — BUGFIX: a device holding an OLD password could never be unlocked with the new one. Every request to the server carries the saved password, and that attachment was overwriting the password you typed on the unlock screen — so the app kept sending the old key and the server kept refusing it, no matter what you entered. On a device that had never been unlocked before, or whose saved password was still current, everything looked fine, which is why this only showed up on some devices. The unlock attempt now always sends exactly what you type. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) — on a phone, fully close the tab and reopen it.
